description: This file defines the ErrorResponse class used for handling error responses within the JWT exception handling component of the security package in the project. It includes fields for status, error, message, and timestamp, and utilizes annotations for JSON formatting and Lombok code generation.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: A data class representing error details to be sent as JSON in API responses, with fields for status, error message, detailed message, and timestamp, built using Lombok annotations.

methods.name: ErrorResponse (builder)
methods.description: Builder pattern constructor for creating ErrorResponse instances with specified field values.
